name: Linen Table Runner
description:
KEY FEATURES

    - Crafted from high-quality linen fabric, offering a soft texture, natural appearance, and excellent durability for everyday use.
    - Lightweight, wrinkle-resistant, and designed to drape beautifully on dining, coffee, console, or entryway tables.
    - Features neatly hemmed edges for a clean finish and enhanced durability.
    - Reusable, machine washable, and easy to maintain for long-lasting use.

  • Printing Technology:
    - Uses high-quality heat transfer printing technology for sharp details, vibrant colors, and long-lasting image quality.
    - 1-sided printing with vibrant colors and sharp image details.
     
  • Functional & Usage:
    - Designed to decorate dining tables, kitchen tables, coffee tables, console tables, buffet tables, and entryway tables.
    - Protects table surfaces from scratches while adding an elegant decorative accent.
    - Perfect for everyday dining, family gatherings, holiday meals, weddings, anniversaries, and seasonal home décor.
    - Creates a warm and inviting atmosphere for kitchens, dining rooms, living rooms, restaurants, cafés, and event venues.
    - Easy to fold, store, and reuse throughout the year for different occasions and celebrations.
     
  • Perfect Gift for Any Occasion:
    - A thoughtful gift for family members, friends, newlyweds, couples, or anyone who enjoys home decorating.
    - Perfect for Housewarming, Weddings, Anniversaries, Birthdays, Mother's Day, Father's Day, Christmas, Thanksgiving, Easter, and other special celebrations.
    - An excellent personalized décor piece for holiday gatherings, family dinners, bridal showers, baby showers, and seasonal events.
    - A beautiful keepsake that adds warmth, personality, and elegance to any dining or living space.

 

SPECIFICATION

  • Processing Time: 3-5 working days on average after payment, and all designs are updated correctly
  • Shipping Time: 7-15 working days on average (US)
  • Packaging: 1 x  Linen Table Runner

 

NOTE

Print Guidelines

Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.
    • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
